title: Adaptive calibration checkpoint and staged rollback Sentry for precision-induced regressions
creator: Aisha Mehta
description: Introduce an adaptive calibration checkpoint that evaluates FP8/INT8 candidate builds against a compact golden dataset during micro-canary traffic. If the checkpoint detects statistically significant precision degradation on production-like slices, automatically steer traffic to a verified FP32/FP16 variant and trigger automated recalibration workflows. The feature should minimize customer-blind regressions during quantized rollouts while keeping rollback actions surgical and observable.
background: We have recurring incidents where a quantized model variant (INT8/FP8) exhibits slice-specific accuracy regressions under real traffic even though offline calibration metrics looked good. Current canary logic is coarse: either promote or revert the whole rollout. This ticket aims to add checkpoints that run lightweight accuracy probes and allow traffic steering per-customer or per-route, plus an automated recalibration attempt before a full rollback.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Micro-canary traffic path invokes calibration checkpoint for every new quantized build.
2) Checkpoint evaluates candidate against a configurable golden set and per-slice thresholds within 30s of build activation.
3) If a build fails accuracy gates on any monitored slice, system routes affected slice traffic to fallback variant automatically and emits an incident with diagnostics.
4) An automated recalibration job is queued and will attempt two independent calibration strategies; if recalibration passes, traffic can be re-merged via an automated verification gate.
5) All events (fail/pass/recalibration/traffic-steer) are recorded in Console: rollout timeline, per-slice metrics, and token-level latency cost delta.
6) Feature gated and opt-in per-customer with sane defaults for hosted plans.
design_notes:
- Checkpoint is a lightweight evaluator: sample N requests per minute per route (default N=50) and compare logits/top-k/EM where applicable.
- Use stratified slices (customer_id, prompt_type, payload_length_bucket) to detect localized regressions.
- Statistical test: paired bootstrap on accuracy metric (default alpha=0.01) + effect size threshold.
- Recalibration strategies: 1) per-layer scale re-estimation using existing calibration harness; 2) hybrid quant (keep attention key/value in FP16 while quantizing others).
- Traffic steering implemented as routing policy override at the request-router layer with sticky session awareness.
- Provide API for customers to opt-out or configure thresholds and golden set paths.
implementation_plan:
1) Instrument micro-canary path to mirror small % of traffic to candidate + checkpoint service (week 1).
2) Implement golden-set evaluator service that ingests candidate outputs and computes per-slice statistics (week 2).
3) Add routing hook to apply per-slice fallback overrides (week 3).
4) Wire automated recalibration orchestrator to kick off calibration jobs and collect artifacts (week 4).
5) Add console UI panels + timeline events and alerting rules (week 5).
6) Run end-to-end internal rollout against sample customers and tune thresholds (week 6).
7) Soft launch behind feature flag and monitor for two weeks before full release (week 7-8).
testing_plan:
- Unit tests for statistical gate logic and routing override.
- Integration tests with calibration harness running small synthetic models to validate steer->recalibrate->verify loop.
- Load tests to ensure checkpointing adds <2ms median overhead to request path when sampling disabled and <15ms when active sampling occurs.
- Canary on internal beta orgs with synthetic golden set scenarios: regress, borderline, and harmless variance.
- Run A/B accuracy comparisons: log false-positive and false-negative rates for detection thresholds and iterate.
rollback_strategy:
- If the checkpoint or routing hook causes unexpected latency or errors, quickly disable feature flag which reverts to current rollout behavior.
- For per-build failures detected by checkpoint, immediate traffic steer to fallback variant (no global rollback).
- If automated recalibration fails twice or if the fallback variant shows degraded latency beyond SLOs, perform full rollback of quantized rollout and notify SRE + PM.
- Post-incident: capture traces, full calibration artifacts, and schedule root-cause retro.
observability_requirements:
- Timeline events: build-activated, checkpoint-run, gate-result, traffic-steer, recalibration-start/finish, verification-result.
- Per-slice metrics: sample-count, accuracy, latency, token-cost-delta.
- Alerts: immediate P1 alert on any gate failure affecting >2% of production traffic or 3+ high-value customers.
- Dashboards: per-release quantization health view and a per-customer impacted routes table.
